review_source: Independent reread of the pinned OPM brochure before seeing any model outputs. No model-visible inputs or answer values changed. Arrays are AND requirements containing OR alternatives. A page may satisfy more than one requirement.

amendments.reason: The US benefit reduction also appears on pp. 35/76 and the overseas hospital exception on p. 131. Physical p. 24 alone satisfies both requirements.

Page 78 refers to an overnight inpatient setting and does not establish the observation-only rule. Pages 76 and 77 explicitly classify observation services as outpatient; pp. 156/157 directly explain overnight observation.
Page 131 independently states Standard has no overseas deductible. Page 139 independently states the one-year overseas pharmacy filing deadline. Page 132 gives both.
